Absolutely Amazing Food and Exceptional Service
Oct 2025 • Couples
We dined at Spice Viet recently. The food was divine and the service by Phat was exceptional. We started with coconut-covered chicken wings,followed by stir-fried beef and fried onion and grilled chicken rice vermicelli with lemongrass. The flavours were absolutely amazing. Can thoroughly recommend. The best place to eat in Hoi Chi Minh.
